This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
 performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Mostafa Abd El-Hameed El-Deeb, accepted by eng. 
 Yosry Abd El-Maksuod: general director, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: MDEPC inspection 
 and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and approved by eng. 
 Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha Power 
 Station.

This document accepted by 
 eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
 MDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: MDEPC planning. & financial 
 prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.

items: A work order must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Unit out of service.
Complete maintenance tool set
Torque wrench, Hammer, Dial indicator
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Suitable Lifting device, Feeler gauge

Remove the nuts from the gland bolts 17B and 
 remove glands (17) from the shaft (6) The gland halves are separable .

Remove all nuts or cap screws from the upper 
 casing (1B) and from the bearing caps (41).

Screw down the jack screws to separate the 
 upper and lower casings. turn the jack screws back after the case halves have 
 separated to avoid interference at reassembly.
Match mark and remove both bearing caps (41).

Attach hoist to the eye bolt (S) to lift upper 
 casing (1B).

Place slings around the shaft near the bearing 
 housings and lift rotating element from lower casing (1A) tap lightly on the 
 underside of the bearing housings to separate the housings from the brackets.

Place rotating element in a convenient work 
 place.
Blow dry with clean dry compressed air.

Clean the bearing as described in bulletin No. 
 2880549.

Coat 
 the shaft ( 6 ) lightly with oil.
Place impeller keys (32) on shaft.

Install O-rings in shaft sleeves ( 14 ), coat 
 with oil and screw sleeves on shaft to loosely butt the impeller hub.

Install thee stuffing box bushing ( 63 ) and 
 lantern ring (29) on the shaft. If a mechanical seal is used, install 
 according to the seal manufacturers 
 instructions.
Locate casing rings (7) on impeller.
Place water deflectors (40A) on shaft.

Insert bearings (16), shield side first, into 
 housings (31).

Press housing bearing assemblies on shaft to 
 bottom with water deflectors refer to bulletin no. 2880549 for procedure ( 
 mounting bearings ).
Install bearing lock washer bearing.

Install gaskets (73B) on bearing covers. Cut 
 replacement gaskets from 1/16 inch No. 444 vellumoid.

Attach bearing covers (35, 37) in the 
 assembled position the grease fittings must be located on top. Install 
 coupling key; assemble coupling half on the shaft and tighten the setscrew.

Use the upper casing (1B) as a template to 
 cut a gasket (73A) from 1/64 inch vellumoid. Machined surfaces of both casings 
 must be perfectly clean and free from burrs and nicks.

Affix the new gasket to lower casing (1A) 
 with shellac.

Use slings around the shaft near bearings to 
 set rotating element into lower casing. Position the casing rings (7) and both 
 bearing housings so that all dowel pins engage.

Assemble both bearing caps and tighten the 
 cap screws.

Adjust the shaft sleeves (14) to center the 
 impeller in the lower casing. Tighten the setscrews. Make sure that impeller 
 is centered.

Cover the top side of the casing gasket with 
 a mixture of graphite and oil. Install the gland bolts. carefully locate the 
 upper casing on the lower, making certain the dowel pins engage. Attach case 
 nuts and alternately tighten at diagonally opposite positions rotate shaft 
 by hand to check that it runs free.

Withdraw the lantern rings (29) and push the 
 bushings (63) to the rear of the stuffing boxes. Insert the same number of 
 packing ring as were found during disassembly, on each side of the lantern 
 ring. Insert each ring separately and stagger the joints of successive rings 
 90. Insert the glands (17) and set the nuts finger tight do not use a 
 wrench.

Rotate shaft by hand to check that it runs 
 free.

Replace all drain plugs removed during 
 disassembly.
Re-lubricate the bearings refer to bulletin no. 2880549.

Follow instructions in bulletin No. 2880549 to check out the pump after repair 
 and place the pump in service.

Introduction

Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
